places.name: Lily's Bedroom
places.design: A small child’s bedroom in an old house. Peeling, pale grey floral wallpaper. Main colours are muted teal-grey shadows with dabs of sodium-amber from the light sources. Key objects: a single bed under the window with a star-patterned duvet, a wooden bedside table holding a now-dead ceramic star night-light (formerly warm amber) and a baby monitor, a low, cluttered bookshelf. The only available light at night is the red accent LED of the monitor. Pre-dawn brings a cold, grey cast through condensation-blurred windowpanes.

places.name: Mara's Bedroom
places.design: A spartan, dim adult bedroom. Walls are a flat, cold blue-grey. Furnished with a simple double bed on a wrought-iron frame and a single wooden nightstand. The only consistent light source is the row of red indicator LEDs on the baby monitor receiver. A small, muted digital clock adds a faint green glow. The bedding is plain, washed-out cotton. Shadows are deep and absolute in the corners beyond the bed.

places.name: The Upstairs Landing
places.design: A long, narrow upstairs hallway in the same old house. Bare, scuffed wooden floorboards. Walls painted a now-grubby off-white. A single, old ceiling fixture with a failing, flickering filament bulb (cold, stark white) provides the only light, leaving deep pools of shadow at either end. A worn runner rug lies crumpled near the top of the stairs. The doors along the hall are heavy, dark-stained wood.
